to: AI connector (ChatGPT, Claude and other Marketplace apps)
plan_needed: Any HubSpot plan, including free tools. Needs a Super Admin. Only required when people without Super Admin or App Marketplace Access want to connect.

steps.do: Click the settings icon
Go to Integrations > Connected Apps
Open the Approved apps tab and click Approve apps
steps.see: A search for apps to approve

steps.do: Search for and select the app (for example the HubSpot connector for ChatGPT or Claude)
steps.see: The app's listing with a Manage access banner

steps.do: Click Approve
Choose who can install: Admins, Specific users and teams, or Everyone
Click Next: Review data permissions
Turn optional permissions on or off, then click Approve app
steps.see: The app is approved and the chosen people can now connect it

plan_needed: Any HubSpot plan, including free tools, plus a ChatGPT (OpenAI) account. HubSpot names no ChatGPT plan; OpenAI's own plan rules weren't confirmed. Users without Super Admin or App Marketplace Access need the connector approved first.

steps.do: Click your profile icon, then Settings
Click Apps
Select HubSpot, then click Connect
Click Continue to HubSpot
Log in to HubSpot and pick the HubSpot account to connect
steps.see: The page 'Connecting HubSpot Connector for ChatGPT to HubSpot'

steps.do: Choose the permissions to allow and click Connect App
steps.see: You're sent back to ChatGPT, connected

steps.do: Click + > More > HubSpot, or mention 'HubSpot' in your prompt
steps.see: ChatGPT can now answer from your HubSpot data

steps.do: For a longer report: click + > Deep research, then switch HubSpot on in the Apps dropdown
steps.see: A deep research report with sources in a side panel

steps.where: HubSpot connector tool settings in ChatGPT
steps.do: Set Write tools to Needs Approval
steps.see: ChatGPT asks before creating or updating any record

plan_needed: A paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise) per HubSpot, and any HubSpot plan. On Team or Enterprise an Owner must add the connector first. Users without Super Admin or App Marketplace Access need HubSpot approval first.

steps.where: claude.ai or the Claude desktop app
steps.do: Go to Customize > Connectors
Select Discover, type 'HubSpot' in Search connectors and open the listing
Select Connect to Claude (Team or Enterprise members see Request if an Owner hasn't added it)
Sign in and choose the HubSpot account
Choose what to allow and approve (HubSpot's button reads Connect app)
Check HubSpot under Your connectors
Select + > Connectors and switch HubSpot on
steps.see: Claude can use HubSpot in this conversation

steps.do: Under Tool permissions, set write tools to Needs approval
steps.see: Claude asks before creating or updating any record

plan_needed: Claude Team or Enterprise, Owner role. Each member still connects their own HubSpot login afterwards.

steps.do: Go to Customize > Connectors and select Discover
Find HubSpot
Select Connect for your team
steps.see: HubSpot is added for everyone in the organisation

steps.do: To try it alone first, select the arrow beside Connect for your team and choose Connect just for me
Connect your own account with Connect to Claude
Check Requested by your team for member requests
steps.see: Pending requests to enable or dismiss

plan_needed: Microsoft 365 admin. Users need a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence or the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat add-on with an eligible Microsoft 365 licence (HubSpot's wording). Any HubSpot plan; a HubSpot Super Admin or App Marketplace user makes the first connection.

steps.do: Go to Agents > All agents
Search for HubSpot
steps.see: The HubSpot agent and its status

steps.do: Check the status is Available; if not, open it and select Unblock
Choose who can install it; All users in the organization can install saves people adding it themselves
steps.see: The agent is available to the chosen users

plan_needed: Microsoft 365 Copilot licence or the Copilot Chat add-on (HubSpot's wording), after the admin has made the agent available. Any HubSpot plan. Read-only.

steps.where: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat or Copilot in Microsoft Teams
steps.do: Open it
steps.see: Copilot with an Agents list in the left sidebar

steps.do: Click HubSpot
steps.see: The HubSpot agent with suggested prompts

steps.do: Type a prompt, or pick a suggested HubSpot prompt
Click Sign in to HubSpot
Choose your HubSpot account and permissions, then click Connect app
steps.see: Copilot answers using your HubSpot data

from: Microsoft Copilot Chat (Microsoft's HubSpot federated connector)
plan_needed: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat with the connector enabled by the tenant admin (Microsoft-published federated connectors are on by default). Licence requirement not confirmed. Your own HubSpot login.

steps.do: Open it
Select the ... menu, then Settings
Select Sources in the left pane
Find HubSpot, select Connect and sign in with your own HubSpot login
steps.see: HubSpot is connected as a source

steps.do: Ask your question, naming HubSpot in the prompt
steps.see: Copilot fetches live HubSpot data; any write action shows a confirmation card first

plan_needed: Per HubSpot: a paid Google Workspace Business Standard, Business Plus or Enterprise plan with Gemini Alpha (now called Gemini Beta) turned on. Any HubSpot plan. Read-only, English only.

steps.do: Go to gemini.google.com
Click Settings & Help, then Apps
Switch HubSpot on
Sign in with your HubSpot login

plan_needed: Personal: Google AI Pro or Ultra. Work: Business Standard, Business Plus, Enterprise Standard, Enterprise Plus, Enterprise Essentials, Enterprise Essentials Plus or Google AI Pro for Education, with integrations allowed by the Workspace admin. Read-only.

steps.do: Open the integrations page filtered to Gemini integrations
Select HubSpot
Click Connect
Follow the on-screen steps to grant access

steps.where: Gmail, Docs or Sheets, Gemini side panel
steps.do: Type @ and choose HubSpot, then your prompt
steps.see: Gemini answers from your HubSpot data

plan_needed: Gemini Enterprise (Business edition). A HubSpot administrator authorises the connector first. Write capability not stated.

steps.do: A HubSpot administrator authorises the HubSpot connector
steps.see: The connector is authorised for the organisation

steps.where: Gemini Enterprise, Settings & help > Manage team > Connectors
steps.do: Switch the HubSpot connector on
steps.see: HubSpot is available to the team

steps.do: Each person authorises their own HubSpot account
steps.see: Gemini Enterprise can use that person's HubSpot data

plan_needed: Any HubSpot plan, with access to HubSpot's Development area, and an AI tool that supports OAuth with PKCE. Some tools need specific plans (AEO: Marketing Hub Pro or Enterprise; quotes: Revenue Hub Pro or Enterprise).

steps.do: Click Development
Click MCP Connectors
Click Create MCP connector
steps.see: A form for the connector's details

steps.do: Fill in Name, Description, Redirect URL (from your AI tool) and Icon, then click Create
Copy the client ID, client secret and redirect URL
Add an MCP server at https://mcp.hubspot.com using those details
Sign in, choose the HubSpot account, grant permissions and authorise
steps.see: The AI tool is connected to HubSpot

steps.do: Ask it to run get_user_details
steps.see: A list of the objects and tools it can reach

from: AI coding agent (for example Claude Code, Claude Cowork or ChatGPT's Codex)
plan_needed: Any HubSpot plan (beta). A Super Admin must allow you to connect. Claude Cowork Team or Enterprise may need api.hubapi.com allowed by an admin.

steps.do: Open it
Paste HubSpot's install prompt
steps.see: The agent installs the CLI, starts sign-in and adds HubSpot's skills

steps.do: Sign in to HubSpot when asked
steps.see: The permissions the CLI is asking for

steps.do: Review the requested permissions
steps.see: What the agent will be able to do with your access

steps.do: Click Connect app
steps.see: The coding agent can work with your HubSpot account

from: AI coding tool (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code or Windsurf)
plan_needed: HubSpot CLI 8.2.0 or later. For building HubSpot apps and website content; the setup page doesn't say it touches CRM data.

steps.do: Run hs --version, or install the CLI with npm install -g @hubspot/cli
Run hs mcp setup
steps.see: A list of supported coding tools

steps.do: Pick your tools with the arrow keys and spacebar, then press Enter
steps.see: A choice of standalone mode or the global CLI

steps.do: Choose standalone mode or the global CLI
Restart it; in Claude Code run /mcp

to: Your own AI model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, xAI or Google)
plan_needed: HubSpot Enterprise (any hub), plus an API key from the AI provider (OpenAI: account owner; Anthropic: admin or developer).

steps.do: Go to More > Automation > Workflows
Open or create a workflow and set its enrolment triggers
Click the + icon and search for Use a custom LLM
In AI provider, click Connect next to your provider
steps.see: A dialog asking for an API key

steps.do: Paste your API key and click Connect to [LLM provider]
Choose an AI model, write the Prompt message, and set Temperature and Reasoning effort under Advanced settings if needed
Click Save
steps.see: The workflow will call your model when it runs

to: Apps installed from HubSpot's App Marketplace (for example Slack, Gmail, Google Docs, Teams)
plan_needed: Any HubSpot plan with Breeze Assistant switched on. Installing an unapproved Marketplace app may need Super Admin approval.

steps.do: Select the app and click Install
Finish the install and read the setup guide in the Overview section
Click Breeze Assistant
steps.see: Breeze Assistant with a right-hand panel

steps.do: Use the Apps dropdown to pick sources, or turn on Use all apps as sources
steps.see: Breeze Assistant can search the chosen apps
